parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID for which to create the IP/VPC whitelist.

parameters.name: WhiteListItem
parameters.description: The whitelist IP or VPC ID. IP addresses are specified in CIDR block format.

parameters.name: WhiteListType
parameters.description:
- The whitelist type.

- WhiteListType set to 1: IP whitelist type.

- WhiteListType set to 2: VPC ID whitelist type.

- The VPC whitelist applies only to instances whose VPC access point is of the anytunnel type. The VPC access point of the latest version instances is of the privateLink type. You cannot set a VPC whitelist for privateLink instances.
